passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.673
passages.text: est aqua Mercurii portae vicina Capenae;

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.674
passages.text: si iuvat expertis credere, numen habet.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.675
passages.text: huc venit incinctus tunica mercator et urna

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.676
passages.text: purus suffita, quam ferat, haurit aquam,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.677
passages.text: uda fit hinc laurus, lauro sparguntur ab uda

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.678
passages.text: omnia, quae dominos sunt habitura novos;

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.679
passages.text: spargit et ipse suos lauro rorante capillos

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.680
passages.text: et peragit solita fallere voce preces:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.681
passages.text: ablue praeteriti periuria temporis, inquit

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.682
passages.text: ‘ablue praeteritae perfida verba die.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.683
passages.text: sive ego te feci testem falsove citavi

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.684
passages.text: non audituri numina magna Iovis,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.685
passages.text: sive deum prudens alium divamve fefelli,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.686
passages.text: abstulerint celeres improba verba Noti,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.687
passages.text: et pateant veniente die periuria nobis,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.688
passages.text: nec curent superi si qua locutus ero.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.689
passages.text: da modo lucra mihi, da facto gaudia lucro,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.690
passages.text: et fac, ut emptori verba dedisse iuvet.’

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.691
passages.text: talia Mercurius poscentem ridet ab alto,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.692
passages.text: se memor Ortygias surripuisse boves.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.693
passages.text: At mihi pande, precor, tanto meliora petenti,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.694
passages.text: in Geminos ex quo tempore Phoebus eat.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.695
passages.text: ‘cum totidem de mense dies superesse videbis,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.696
passages.text: quot sunt Herculei facta laboris’ ait.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.697
passages.text: dic ego respondi causam mihi sideris huius.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.698
passages.text: causam facundo reddidit ore deus:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.699
passages.text: ‘abstulerant raptas Phoeben Phoebesque sororem

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.700
passages.text: Tyndaridae fratres, hic eques, ille pugil.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.701
passages.text: bella parant repetuntque suas et frater et Idas,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.702
passages.text: Leucippo fieri pactus uterque gener.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.703
passages.text: his amor, ut repetant, illis, ut reddere nolint,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.704
passages.text: suadet; et ex causa pugnat uterque pari.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.705
passages.text: effugere Oebalidae cursu potuere sequentes,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.706
passages.text: sed visum celeri vincere turpe fuga.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.707
passages.text: Uber ab arboribus locus est, apta area pugnae:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.708
passages.text: constiterant illic: nomen Aphidna loco.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.709
passages.text: pectora traiectus Lynceo Castor ab ense

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.710
passages.text: non expectato volnere pressit humum,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.711
passages.text: ultor adest Pollux et Lyncea perforat hasta,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.712
passages.text: qua cervix humeros continuata premit,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.713
passages.text: ibat in hunc Idas vixque est Iovis igne repulsus,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.714
passages.text: tela tamen dextrae fulmine rapta negant.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.715
passages.text: iamque tibi, Pollux, caelum sublime patebat,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.716
passages.text: cum mea dixisti ‘percipe verba, pater:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.717
passages.text: quod mihi das uni caelum, partire duobus:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.718
passages.text: dimidium toto munere maius erit.’

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.719
passages.text: dixit et alterna fratrem statione redemit.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.720
passages.text: utile sollicitae sidus utrumque rati.’

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.721
passages.text: Ad Ianum redeat, qui quaerit, Agonia quid sint:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.722
passages.text: quae tamen in fastis hoc quoque tempus habent.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.723
passages.text: Nocte sequente diem canis Erigoneius exit:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.724
passages.text: est alio signi reddita causa loco.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.725
passages.text: Proxima Volcani lux est, Tubilustria dicunt:

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.726
passages.text: lustrantur purae, quas facit ille, tubae.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.727
passages.text: Quattuor inde notis locus est, quibus ordine lectis

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.728
passages.text: vel mos sacrorum vel fuga regis inest.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.729
passages.text: Nec te praetereo, populi Fortuna potentis

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.730
passages.text: Publica, cui templum luce sequente datum est.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.731
passages.text: hanc ubi dives aquis acceperit Amphitrite,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.732
passages.text: grata Iovi fulvae rostra videbis avis.

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.733
passages.text: Auferet ex oculis veniens aurora Booten,

passages.label: Ov. Fast. 5.734
passages.text: continuaque die sidus Hyantis erit.
